messages:
sophie_support: FYI customer reports rerank endpoint returning weird scores after upgrading @redwood/ts-sdk from 1.4.1 -> 1.5.0. Scores look inverted and some candidates missing. customer attached minimal repro.
sophie_support: (customer) 'We call rerank with 1 query + 10 candidates, but response has only 5 candidates and score values are strings like "0.12" instead of numbers.'
alex_eng: can you paste the repro snippet here?
sophie_support: here is the TS snippet the customer used:
```ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/ts-sdk';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const res = await client.rerank({
  query: 'best restaurants',
  candidates: [
    { id: 'c1', text: 'Italian near me' },
    { id: 'c2', text: 'Sushi place' },
    // ... total 10
  ]
});
console.log(res);
```
sophie_support: and the raw response they got (truncated):
```json
{ "candidates": [ { "id": "c1", "score": "0.72" }, { "id": "c3", "score": "0.18" } ], "count": 2 }
```
ryan_eng: odd. API should return numeric scores and all candidates unless you pass top_k. Did they set top_k?
sophie_support: customer says they did not. they only upgraded the SDK, same call worked on 1.4.1.
ryan_eng: stepping through the TS SDK quickly — I suspect serialization bug. @alex_eng can you grep for rerank payload assembly?
alex_eng: found something suspicious: packages/ts-sdk/src/rerank.ts serializes candidates using `form.append('candidates', JSON.stringify(list))` and when the code builds FormData it ends up doing multiple string appends and some arrays become comma-joined strings. on node-fetch this can produce weird payload shapes. also I see score parsing in response util casts `Number(entry.score)` but only after trimming quotes; if API returns "0.12" as a string we still coerce ok but missing candidates implies the server interprets the body shape incorrectly.
ryan_eng: yeah server expects top-level `candidates: [{id,text},...]` in JSON body. The SDK switched to multipart/form-data in 1.5.0 for other endpoints and the rerank method accidentally used that path too. server dropped malformed part.
maria_pm: can we confirm quickly with curl + JSON to show it works? then share workaround to customer.
sophie_support: customer tried curl and confirmed JSON body works. they used: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' 
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
 -d '{"query":"best restaurants","candidates":[{"id":"c1","text":"Italian"}, {"id":"c2","text":"Sushi"}] }'
```
response: returns 2 numeric scores and both candidates.
ryan_eng: I opened PR #7823 that reverts rerank to JSON body and adds unit tests for node and browser. quick patch: change to `client.rerank({ asJson: true })`? not yet exposed. For now workaround: pin @redwood/ts-sdk@1.4.1 or call API directly via fetch/curl. I'll push hotfix.
alex_eng: thanks. adding a small migration note to the release notes.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: hotfix/rerank-json-revert -> staging (job #4589) :rocket:
ryan_eng: hotfix merged, patch release 1.5.1 tagged (commit 7a3c9f4). CI passing.
sophie_support: shared workaround + ETA with customer (patch release in ~30m). asked them to confirm when they can test.
bob_acme: confirming — tested pinned 1.4.1 and workaround curl; both produce correct numeric scores and full candidate list. thanks for the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
sophie_support: thanks @bob_acme — we will follow up once 1.5.1 is live. switching ticket to escalated->in-progress.
alex_eng: follow-up: PR link https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/7823, release changelog entry will mention "fix: rerank serialization bug in TS SDK that caused truncated candidate lists and stringified scores"
ryan_eng: i'll monitor staging deploy and roll to prod after smoke tests. close when prod live.
sophie_support: noted, will update ticket and notify customer. :lock: end of thread
